theorems.name: Submission.frt_varifold_eq_tangent_graph_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), (∃ η : Euclidean N → Measure (Grassmannian N n), (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, IsProbabilityMeasure (η x) ∧ ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ S, β S ∂(η x)))) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), MeasurableSet A → (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → ∫⁻ z in A ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal (β z.2) ∂V.measure = ∫⁻ x in A, (∫⁻ S, ENNReal.ofReal (β S) ∂(η x)) ∂V.weight) → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ) → ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → NullMeasurableSet {x | ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ ∧ (x, T) ∈ A} V.weight ∧ V.measure A = V.weight {x | ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ ∧ (x, T) ∈ A}
